metadata.track_name: XNL Collaborative Editor Demo (Bun, no framework)
metadata.goal: Build a minimal multi-client / single-server collaborative editor for the XNL text DSL. Sync payload should be user edit intent (XnlMutation[] ops), with snapshot-based resync as recovery.

milestone.name: MVP
milestone.deliverables: Bun server + plain HTML client; two clients can edit same doc; operations are broadcast and applied; baseRev mismatches trigger resync; local edits are preserved by re-diffing against snapshot.

phase.name: Project Setup
phase.goal: Scaffold braid-demo/ project and wire XNL library.

tasks.task:
Create a minimal Bun TypeScript project under braid-demo/ with src/ and public/ layout.
`bun run dev` starts the server GET / serves a static HTML page from public/
Bun
TypeScript
braid-demo/ (new project root)

Server can import XNL parser and mutation functions Client bundle can import the same APIs via bun build
vendor/xnl.ts/src/index.ts vendor/xnl.ts/tests

gate_criteria.criterion: All P0 tasks in P1 are DONE
Dev server serves the client page, and client JS loads

phase.name: Protocol + Server
phase.goal: Define message protocol and implement a single-server collaboration backend.

tasks.task:
Define JSON message shapes for connect, snapshot, op, ack, resync, and error.
Types exist in a single shared module (server + client) Each message includes docId and correlation IDs (clientId/opId) where relevant

Server maintains canonical state per docId: {rev, text, ast}. T2.1
Server can create/load a doc with a default initial text Parsing failures are handled (doc stays valid; errors reported)

On connect, server sends a snapshot {rev, text} for the requested docId. T2.2
New client receives snapshot before sending ops Multiple clients can connect simultaneously

Server accepts client ops carrying XnlMutation[] with baseRev. If baseRev matches, apply and broadcast. If baseRev mismatches, request resync (send latest snapshot). T2.3
Accepted op increments rev and is broadcast to all clients Client receives ack with server-assigned rev On baseRev mismatch, server sends resync snapshot

gate_criteria.criterion: Two WS clients can connect and receive identical snapshots
At least one op round-trip works (op -> apply -> broadcast -> ack)

phase.name: Client Engine
phase.goal: Implement no-framework client collaboration logic and operation queueing.

tasks.task:
Implement connect/reconnect, snapshot handling, and per-doc state {baseRev, baseText, baseAst}. T2.3
Client does not send ops before snapshot Client shows connection status (connected/disconnected)

On text changes, parse XNL and compute diffNodes(prevAst, nextAst) to produce XnlMutation[] intent. Queue ops and send sequentially with baseRev. T1.2
Client sends ops containing XnlMutation[] (not snapshots) Client blocks sending when text is unparseable and surfaces parse error

Apply server-broadcast ops to the local base state. Keep editor text in sync with updated base. T2.4
Remote edits update local editor text Client maintains monotonically increasing baseRev from server

On resync snapshot, replace local base state with snapshot, then preserve local unsent edits by re-parsing current editor text and re-diffing against snapshot AST. T2.4
On baseRev mismatch, client converges after resync Local unsent edits are not silently discarded

gate_criteria.criterion: Two browser tabs converge under concurrent edits (with possible resync)
Primary sync path uses intent ops; snapshots only for join/resync

phase.name: Minimal UI
phase.goal: Provide a simple UI to edit text and observe collaboration state.

tasks.task:
Create a minimal page with textarea editor, connection status, rev indicator, and an op log. T3.1
User can edit text in a textarea Status panel shows rev and connection state Op log lists sent/received ops (high-level)

task.name: Wire UI events to client engine

tasks.task:
Ensure UI input drives intent ops and UI reflects remote ops/resync/parse errors. T4.1
Parse error is visible and prevents sending Op log distinguishes local vs remote ops

gate_criteria.criterion: UI surfaces enough info to debug collaboration flows (rev, errors, ops)

phase.name: Verification
phase.goal: Verify behavior with a small manual test matrix and a repeatable smoke workflow.

tasks.task:
Write a short test checklist (two tabs, concurrent edits, reconnect, parse errors, resync).
Checklist covers join, concurrent edits, resync, reconnect

Build and run the demo, validate two clients converge under concurrent edits. T5.1
`bun run build` succeeds Two browser tabs converge after concurrent edits

validations.validation:
Verify two browser tabs editing the same doc converge.
Both tabs receive the same initial snapshot Concurrent edits converge (may involve resync) Local edits are preserved across resync by re-diffing

Verify that the normal sync payload is intent ops (XnlMutation[]), not snapshots.
Outgoing messages contain mutation arrays + baseRev Snapshots are only used for initial join and resync recovery

risk.name: True OT transform for tree ops is complex
risk.impact: Conflicts may require resync more often than ideal
risk.mitigation: Use snapshot-based resync + re-diff rebase for MVP; revisit operation transformation later.

risk.name: Parser rejects intermediate edits
risk.impact: User can be temporarily blocked from syncing while typing invalid partial text
risk.mitigation: Debounce diffs, surface parse errors clearly, and keep local edits while waiting for valid parse.
